content:
Show Your Work: Understanding Time and Effort Reporting

Hello Morgan State University Faculty & Staff, In this module, we will review key processes for time and effort on sponsored projects at Morgan State University. Topics include what is effort reporting, why effort reporting is so important, how we source our effort data, the effort certification process, and potential errors and how to correct them. We strive to continuously review these lessons to provide up-to-date guidance on Morgan’s sponsored project processes. For questions related to the activities covered in this module that are not addressed in the module content, please contact the ORA Training and Communications Coordinator: Mr. Ryan Mobley, CRA, CFRA, CPRA Email: ryan.mobley@morgan.edu Phone: 443-885-4771 Thank you, ORA Training Team

Self-paced ORA eTraining module. Source: https://share.articulate.com/s01WpXKAGFN1dft3QDlow

This module has 8 lessons, each a separate knowledge base entry:
1. Time and Effort Defined
2. Who Certifies Effort?
3. Significance of Effort Reporting
4. Institutional Base Salary (IBS)
5. Effort Reporting at MSU
6. Case Studies
7. Time and Effort Knowledge Review
8. Message from ORA

Files provided in this module:
